remarks:
This is an exceptional real estate listing for a versatile, turn-key rural property in North Collins, NY. This offers 41.2 acres total at the end of Applewood Road, featuring ~3 acres cleared
(ideal for a home site) and ATV trails throughout. Modern Utilities include~ New 200-amp electrical service, New water well (dug in 2020), New natural gas connection line. On-Site Structures &
Living Quarters include~ 40' x 24' Pole Barn: Features a second-floor loft for maximum storage or workshop space, 12' x 12' Cabin/Bunkhouse: Outfitted with bunks and a heater—ready for
immediate overnight stays or hunting camp use, 30' x 17' Garage: Ample room for vehicle, tractor, or equipment storage, 14' x 14' Shelter: Additional outdoor storage or animal/equipment
shelter. This land includes interconnected concrete pads surrounding all main structures. Also on site a 2018 Jayco Camper: A 36-foot travel trailer included with the sale, offering turn-key
living while you plan or build.

Land not to be walked without an appointment !!
